actualFailureBeingRepaired.parentReportedReason: existing maintenance mode created absent DB
actualFailureBeingRepaired.scope: RocksDB DB::Open can create the directory even when database create_if_missing=false

productionDeltaVerified: FileSystemWrapper is installed as the actual modern FileSystem through NewCompositeEnv, not merely an old Env virtual override that direct FileSystem calls could bypass.
CreateDir always rejects. CreateDirIfMissing delegates only to NewDirectory, which opens an existing directory or returns failure; it cannot run a mkdir-capable call after a separate existence test.

If the requested directory is already absent or disappears before NewDirectory acquisition, opening fails without recreating it. Disappearance after the directory-open callback cannot become a mkdir through these intercepted callbacks.

CompositeEnv and its shared FileSystem wrapper have process static lifetime; automatic ChainStore DB destruction joins its background work before normal static teardown. No public header, ChainStore member or method signature is changed.

Only OpenMode::ReadWriteExisting assigns the wrapper. Existing ReadWrite/ReadOnly values, default ReadWrite and their initialization paths remain unchanged. Existing schema refusal and synchronous WAL options are retained.
newTestStaticScope: Original absent-path refusal is retained, followed within the same existing-mode-never-creates-missing-db category by a private synthetic clone, successful closed ReadOnly probe, rename away, refused existing-only acquisition, absent old path and unchanged moved logical contents.
No additional category identifier is introduced; the existing thirty-category schema is unchanged by this exact patch.

The new case exercises disappearance between a closed read-only probe and exclusive acquisition; it does not inject a concurrent rename during the filesystem callback itself. Race safety of avoiding check-then-mkdir is a static finding pending execution.
limits: No compiler, tests, DB opening, Docker, runtime or SSH was executed by this reviewer; live source copies and runningr4 binaries were not mutated.
API compatibility inspected against local RocksDB declarations; supported Linux RocksDB8.9 compilation and tests are still required. No binary ABI compatibility or successful regression is claimed.
The fix prohibits directory creation for existing-only mode, not ordinary file writes of an acquired writable database. GC copied-store ownership/path/inventory checks remain separate prerequisites.
NewDirectory return/lifetime contract is delegated to the underlying RocksDB FileSystem; malicious filesystem replacement and arbitrary concurrent host mutations are not newly qualified.
